# LAMMPS Input Script for Na2SiO3 NPT Quenching

units real
atom_style charge
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data /structures/melt/liq4000.dat

# Include potential file
include /potentials/BKS/pot.mod

# Define settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

# Define variables
variable Tstart equal 4000.0
variable Tend equal 300.0
variable Tdamp equal 100.0
variable Pdamp equal 10000.0
variable rate equal 10.0

# Thermo settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Fixes
fix 1 all npt temp ${Tstart} ${Tend} ${Tdamp} iso 0.0 0.0 ${Pdamp}

# Run the simulation
variable nsteps equal (v_Tstart-v_Tend)/v_rate*1000
run ${nsteps}

# Write restart file

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import linregress
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data from CSV files
quenching_data = pd.read_csv('quenching_run.csv')
equilibration_data = pd.read_csv('equilibration_run.csv')

# Combine the data
combined_data = pd.concat([quenching_data, equilibration_data])

# Filter out data beyond 2600 K
filtered_data = combined_data[combined_data['Temp'] <= 2600]

# Separate the data into high and low temperature regions
high_temp_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['Temp'] > 1000]
low_temp_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['Temp'] <= 1000]

# Perform linear regression on both regions
slope_high, intercept_high, _, _, _ = linregress(high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'])
slope_low, intercept_low, _, _, _ = linregress(low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate the intersection point (Tg)
Tg = (intercept_low - intercept_high) / (slope_high - slope_low)

# Plot the data and the fitted lines
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(filtered_data['Temp'], filtered_data['Density'], label='Data', color='gray')
plt.plot(high_temp_data['Temp'], slope_high * high_temp_data['Temp'] + intercept_high, label='High Temp Fit', color='red')
plt.plot(low_temp_data['Temp'], slope_low * low_temp_data['Temp'] + intercept_low, label='Low Temp Fit', color='blue')
plt.axvline(Tg, color='green', linestyle='--', label=f'Tg = {Tg:.2f} K')
plt.xlabel('Temperature (K)')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.title('Density-Temperature Curve')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('density_temperature_plot.png')
plt.close()

# Print the Tg value
print(f"Estimated Tg: {Tg:.2f} K")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/results/10_feb_quenching/gpt_4o/tool_calling/quenching/subtask/level_1/comprehensive/na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_tg_calculation_trial_2/quenching_filtered.csv')

# Filter data for temperatures <= 2600 K
data_filtered = data[data['Temp'] <= 2600]

# Define linear function for fitting
def linear(x, a, b):
    return a * x + b

# Fit the high-temperature regime (supercooled liquid)
high_temp_data = data_filtered[data_filtered['Temp'] > 1500]
popt_high, _ = curve_fit(linear, high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'])

# Fit the low-temperature regime (glassy)
low_temp_data = data_filtered[data_filtered['Temp'] <= 1500]
popt_low, _ = curve_fit(linear, low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate intersection point (Tg)
Tg = (popt_low[1] - popt_high[1]) / (popt_high[0] - popt_low[0])

# Plot the data and fits
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(data_filtered['Temp'], data_filtered['Density'], label='Data')
plt.plot(data_filtered['Temp'], linear(data_filtered['Temp'], *popt_high), label='High Temp Fit', color='red')
plt.plot(data_filtered['Temp'], linear(data_filtered['Temp'], *popt_low), label='Low Temp Fit', color='blue')
plt.axvline(Tg, color='green', linestyle='--', label=f'Tg = {Tg:.2f} K')
plt.xlabel('Temperature (K)')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Density-Temperature Curve with Tg')
plt.savefig('/results/10_feb_quenching/gpt_4o/tool_calling/quenching/subtask/level_1/comprehensive/na2sio3_quenching_1_subtask_tg_calculation_trial_2/density_temperature_plot.png')

high_temp_data = data[data['Temperature'] > mid_temp]

params_low, _ = curve_fit(linear, low_temp_data['Temperature'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate intersection point
# a1 * x + b1 = a2 * x + b2 => x = (b2 - b1) / (a1 - a2)
a1, b1 = params_high
a2, b2 = params_low
Tg = (b2 - b1) / (a1 - a2)
